title: In-vehicle network data processing method, device, equipment and medium based on federated learning

pse.problem: Efficient processing of heterogeneous in-vehicle network data, ensuring real-time response, security, data privacy, and accuracy.
pse.solution_function: Constructs a hierarchical vehicle network structure, groups nodes based on vehicle feature information, deploys message queues, performs local federated learning within each group, aggregates and updates local models, performs global multi-center federated learning to obtain global models for processing in-vehicle network communication data.
pse.solution_structure: Hierarchical structure of the vehicle network, basic layers, basic groups, message queues, vehicles associated with target groups, computing nodes.
pse.solution_implementation: Constructing a hierarchical structure based on historical communication message data and hardware configuration information (bandwidth, communication capabilities); grouping nodes based on vehicle feature information; deploying message queues inside each basic group to obtain target groups; associating and assigning vehicle identifications to target groups; local federated learning within each group; global multi-center federated learning.
pse.effect: Ensures data privacy, accuracy, and efficient processing of in-vehicle network data, meeting real-time response and security requirements.
